knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Scope is set by the accepted work order, and changes are approved.
Damage is recorded separately from cleaning.
Bond decisions are outside the cleaner's authority.

practicalCriteria: Reads a sample work order and identifies inclusions and exclusions.
Documents pre-existing damage and inaccessible areas before a simulated clean.
Holds a simulated extra-work request until priced and approved.
passRule: Inclusions and exclusions identified, pre-work record complete, and extra work held until approved. Observed in a supervised simulation.
